prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: choose Creatify if your main goal is converting product ads for e-commerce
answer_verbatim:
There is no single **best** AI video ad maker for every use case; the top choice depends on whether you need **UGC-style ads, multilingual avatar ads, e-commerce product ads, or full campaign workflows**.[2][3][7]

- **Best overall for many marketers:** **HeyGen** — multiple recent reviews rank it first for ads because of strong avatar quality, multilingual reach, and automated ad creation.[1][17]
- **Best for e-commerce / high-volume product ads:** **Creatify** — reviews consistently call it the strongest choice for product-focused, performance-style ads.[2][7][16]
- **Best for UGC-style performance ads:** **Arcads** or **Creatify**, depending on whether you want realism-first UGC or broader production speed.[3][16]
- **Best all-in-one short-form ad workflow:** **Revid.ai** — one review says it is the best overall AI video editor for ads for short-form paid social.[19]
- **Best budget-friendly option:** **HeyFish** or **AdCreate**, depending on whether you prioritize actor library/templates or broader feature depth.[5][8]

If you want one practical recommendation: **choose HeyGen for the most versatile “best overall” pick**, and **choose Creatify if your main goal is converting product ads for e-commerce**.[1][2][16]
